summary: Recover expired local reservations without a checkout

delivery.outcome: Continue local reservation ownership through explicit fenced recovery of expired missing checkouts and live-owner head checkpoints; ship these material fixes in standard0.20.149.
nonGoals: No automatic takeover or source replay
No recovery of released, frozen, live or already integrated reservations
No expiry extension, protected-policy changes or permission inferred from a snapshot

architecture.decision: Reuse pinned lease transitions, restoration identity/snapshot checks and anchored atomic storage. Missing-checkout recovery requires enabled idle policy, elapsed expiry/idle time, no branch/worktree/live deleted-cwd writer, exact file digest/CAS and fresh explicit caller identity. A separate live-owner checkpoint records current canonical HEAD without extending expiry. Prepared receipts bind both lease versions for idempotent interruption recovery. Existing automatic observer/takeover rules remain conservative.
dataChanges: Monotonic fenced local lease transition and immutable prepare/result receipts; recover returns a new bound restoration request but does not restore source or grant edit/merge authority.
architecture.rollback: Reviewed source revert; retain all reservations, transition receipts, snapshots and worktrees.

validation.evidence: Disposable real Git reproduces expired missing identity deadlock, explicit fresh fenced claim, then same-identity restoration through the existing controller.
Wrong owner/CAS/digest, active/frozen/released/policy-disabled states, deleted-cwd writer, collisions and interrupted writes fail closed or replay the same immutable receipt.
Live owner checkpoint binds actual HEAD without extending TTL; managed version149 projections, all protected Linux/Windows/OneDev checks and independent exact-head publication qualify delivery.
